steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch(e) {} })()

steps.name: verify-flags
steps.eval: (() => { const flags = window.__store.getState().featureFlags; if (!flags.windowGlassTint) throw new Error('windowGlassTint flag OFF'); if (!flags.curtainLightEffect) throw new Error('curtainLightEffect flag OFF') })()

steps.name: probe-state-1
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('PROBE 1: items=' + s.items.length + ' glassTint=' + JSON.stringify(s.glassTint)) })()

steps.name: add-curtains-over-bedroom-windows
steps.eval: (() => { const store = window.__store.getState(); store.setItems([ { id: 'c1', defId: 'curtains', position: [1.7, 0.2], rotation: 0, props: { width: 2.0, height: 2.3, style: 'drawn', color: '#8a7060', pattern: 'plain' } }, { id: 'c2', defId: 'curtains', position: [4.65, 0.2], rotation: 0, props: { width: 2.0, height: 2.3, style: 'drawn', color: '#8a7060', pattern: 'plain' } }, { id: 'c3', defId: 'curtains', position: [7.5, 0.2], rotation: 0, props: { width: 2.0, height: 2.3, style: 'drawn', color: '#8a7060', pattern: 'plain' } } ]) })()

steps.name: open-all-curtains
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const open = { width: 2.0, height: 2.3, style: 'open', color: '#8a7060', pattern: 'plain' }; s.updateItemProps?.('c1', open); s.updateItemProps?.('c2', open); s.updateItemProps?.('c3', open) })()

steps.name: clear-tint-and-close-curtains
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setGlassTint?.(''); const drawn = { width: 2.0, height: 2.3, style: 'drawn', color: '#8a7060', pattern: 'plain' }; s.updateItemProps?.('c1', drawn); s.updateItemProps?.('c2', drawn); s.updateItemProps?.('c3', drawn) })()
